summary: babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<arch>.zip), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js (execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D,'math_init.js')])). math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle using hex-style identifiers and a shuffled numeric string array rotated by a helper (classic obfuscator.io string-array rotation), undocumented in the README. The visible lib/index.js is a copy of the legitimate ornikar/babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined plugin and serves as cover; the install-time attack surface (setup.mjs + Bun + math_init.js) is unrelated to the advertised babel plugin. Using Bun to execute the payload bypasses Node-oriented install-time inspection, and the payload contents cannot be audited by installers before they run.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
